description: Send an email via one or more personalizations, optionally using a dynamic template. Each recipient is appended to the sent log with a queued status.

personalizations.description: List of personalization objects. Each object has a 'to' list of {email, name} recipients and optional 'subject' and 'dynamic_template_data'.

subject.description: Optional subject line; falls back to the template subject or the personalization subject.

content.description: Optional list of content parts (each a {type, value} object).

template_id.description: Optional dynamic template id to send with; must reference an existing template.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {accepted, message_ids, status}; on failure (missing personalizations/from_email or unknown template), output contains an error message.

description: List email templates, optionally filtered by generation.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {result: [template objects]}; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single email template by its id.

template_id.description: The unique id of the template.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the serialized template object with its versions; on failure (template not found), output contains an error message.

subject.description: Optional subject line for the template version.

html_content.description: Optional HTML content for the template version.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created template object with its versions; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List marketing contacts, optionally filtered by email.

email.description: Optional email address to filter contacts by exact match.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {result: [contact objects], contact_count}; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create or update marketing contacts by email, optionally adding them to lists.

contacts.description: List of contact objects with email and optional first_name, last_name, country.

list_ids.description: Optional list of list ids to add the contacts to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {job_id, upserted, contact_ids}; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {result: [list objects]}; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get email statistics for a date range, aggregated per day.

start_date.description: The inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter stats from.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter stats to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of {date, stats: [{metrics}]} objects; on failure, output contains an error message.
